contexts.text: Thou shalt bruise his heel ()... By the heel is meant the lowest Natural, as the Corporeal... AC 259, Explained, Illustrated.
The name of Jacob is from the heel, because the Jewish Church signified by Jacob injured the heel.
The Antediluvians... are in a certain Hell under the heel of the left foot. SE 4217.
In the Word, the soles of the feet, and the heel = the ultimate Natural. AC 2162:2.
Their punishments... are under the heel of the left foot.
The very deceitful sometimes appear high above the head; but their Hell is deep under the heel of the foot...
Biting the heels of the horse... The heel = the lowest Natural... Thus it = that they adhere to the lowest things of nature...
His hand took hold of the heel of Esau () = the lowest of natural good to which it adhered with some power... The heel = the lowest of the Natural.
Heels () = outermost goods.
Biting the heels of the horse = when it consults the lowest intellectual or scientific things, and forms conclusions from them.
They who in the Grand Man correspond to the feet, soles, and heels, are they who are natural; and therefore by... the heels are signified the lowest natural things. AC 9917:end.
Beneath the heel, a little further behind, is a Hell at a great depth. Described. SE 4553.
Such dwell under the right heel, where are adulterers who are also cruel. SE 2622.
Biting the heels of the horse () = fallacies from lowest nature... For the heel = the lowest Natural and Corporeal. References.
He shall ravage the heel () = disorder thence in the Natural... The heel = the lowest Natural.
The Lord's heel, which is the seed of the woman, = the Divine proceeding in ultimates, which is the Word in the sense of the letter.
The heels of the horse = the ultimates of the understanding, which are sensuous things.
They have communication with the foot towards the heel...
What is meant by the heel injured by the serpent; and also by Jacob taking hold of Esau's heel. Explained.
They who are in Falsity are in the place where is the heel. Explained.
This Hell, which occupies the region of the left heel, is at this day much augmented; for they are multiplied from those who are adulterers and cruel...

These things have now taken place in the... region where is the heel of the left foot; but as the heel which had been injured by the descendants of Jacob has been restored by the Advent of the Lord into the world, therefore the whole body is perfect, and the heel or region of the heel consists of those who have joy in the like imaginations... They who make representations of such things as are written in the Lord's Word... occupy that region...
The region of the heel of the right foot, which consists of Falsities, now seems to be not as yet whole...
They who constitute the heel make tallow which they sell...
The heels of the horse = the ultimates of the understanding of truth and good. ( = truths in ultimates, which are sensuous scientifics... AE 581:11.)

Hath lifted up his heel against Me () = to pervert the sense of the letter of the Word even to the denial of the Lord and to the falsification of all truth... Therefore its ultimate sense, which is the mere sense of the letter, corresponds to the heel.
The heel = the ultimate Natural.
The Lord's heel = Divine truth in ultimates, which with us is the sense of the letter. This the sensuous man... perverts... and thus injures. AE 768:3.
